sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: Before the unit test, review how szeretne, kell, and mert combine to express preferences and reasons in a restaurant.

items.english: I would like the set meal because I'm hungry.

sections.content: A full order often chains several of this unit's patterns together: what you'd like (szeretnék/szeretne), what's needed (kell), and why (mert).
